entries.belief: Network namespace containment materially reduces execution risk.
entries.rival: It will be mislabeled as a full sandbox.
entries.probe: Attempt external TCP under network-contained profile and inspect filesystem claim.
entries.observation: Network is isolated where host probe succeeds; filesystem confinement absent.
entries.change: Expose network-contained, never full sandbox; untrusted policy refuses it.

entries.belief: Agent-scoped attention plus leases reduces cross-agent contamination/races.
entries.probe: A stages path; B attempts same path and owner mismatch commit.
entries.observation: Without a lease model the intent boundary is under-specified.
entries.change: Agent sessions + utility namespace + path leases + owner binding.

entries.belief: Repeated evidence rows strengthen a hypothesis.
entries.rival: Rows from one provider are correlated and create fake consensus.
entries.probe: Link repeated pytest evidence from same provider.
entries.observation: Independent source count must remain one.
entries.change: Group by source/provider with diminishing return.

entries.belief: Same-model superiority should be the next evidence frontier.
entries.rival: A synthetic harness could manufacture a result.
entries.probe: Build harness with external commands only and contract-double smoke.
entries.observation: Orchestration can be standardized without embedding model/evaluator.
entries.change: Executable paired A/B harness with strict claim boundary.

entries.belief: Release identity is already synchronized after cloning alpha.8.

claim_boundary: Method trace records engineering belief updates; it is not evidence of AGI capability.
